issues.description: Problem statement (Aufgabe 01) requires output of the zoo name, zoo internet address (url), the Gemeinde name and the Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) only selects the zoo name and url and omits the Gemeinde name and Regierungsbezirk, causing a mismatch between the specification and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the problem statement by selecting the Gemeinde name and Regierungsbezirk in addition to the Zoo name and url and keep the join. For example, update solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql to select: Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and include the WHERE/JOIN condition (Gemeinde.schluessel = Zoo.gemeindeschluessel). Alternatively, adjust the problem text if the intended output is only zoo name and url.
